assessment: This study provides valuable new information on using monosynaptic rabies virus for trans-synaptic tracing, a widely used tool to map synaptic inputs to specific types of neurons in the mammalian brain. The authors provide convincing quantitative information about the efficiency for the rabies virus to cross synapses of visual cortical neurons in the mouse. They further demonstrate that the cortical cell type and location of synapse in the postsynaptic cell do not appear to affect the efficiency for the rabies virus to cross synapses.
